---
name: "🚀 Feature Request / Enhancement"
about: Suggest an idea, enhancement, or new agent tool/node for this project
title: "[FEAT]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "proposal"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. (e.g. *I'm always frustrated when the agent cannot query external REST APIs...*)

## Proposed Solution / Feature

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

- Which node, subgraph, or tool would this feature modify or introduce?
- How does the state schema (`AgentState`) change, if applicable?

## Architecture & Workflow Diagram (Optional)

If applicable, include a small flowchart or ASCII diagram illustrating how this feature fits into the LangGraph state flow:

```text
[Node A] -> [New Feature Node] -> [Node B]
```

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, packages, or models you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, benchmarks, or references to research papers (e.g., Self-RAG, Adaptive RAG, GraphRAG).
